text: I have had unusual discharge from my penis for about a week, but I do not have pain when I pee. Could this be something serious?
I have known gallstones and now I am getting sharp pains in the upper right part of my abdomen. My stomach is also bloated and I am burping a lot.

We are trying to have a baby and gave it a serious try this cycle. We are also planning IVF with ICSI next period, and my doctor gave me Primolut-N from day 16 to day 25. If I am already pregnant, could this have a negative impact?
My 61-year-old brother-in-law has heart artery blockages and we are wondering whether an alternative treatment like Keeley or chelation could avoid surgery.
My boyfriend's semen has chunky jello-like pieces that do not melt. Could this be from past crack use, infertility, or an STD?
I have had a small growth near my anal area since 2010. It slowly grew and is about 1.8 cm now. Today it felt harder, like it is pressure filled. Is this dangerous?
My husband has small fiber neuropathy and takes Lyrica 100 mg twice a day. He has severe joint and muscle pain and spends most days in a recliner. Could Lyrica be the cause?
I had a CT and MRI after ER dizziness and headache, and they found a 1 cm pineal cyst. I am scared and still dizzy.

I had osteomyelitis a few months ago and had the top rib on my left side removed. The stitch area is oozing pus. My surgeon said the chest X-ray looked fine, but my GP thinks there may still be infection and took a swab.

I fell more than a year ago and still have noticeable painless lumps near both knees in the same spot. They shrink somewhat when I take the water pills my doctor prescribed, but they have not gone away. What is the next step?
I have a positive Widal test. My liver function test showed high eosinophils. I vomit out anything I eat and feel intense weakness and fatigue. Please help.
I was stung by a wasp a few minutes ago. I feel anxious, I think I am struggling to breathe, my tongue feels weird, and one side of my lip may be swelling.
I woke up about an hour ago and I cannot move my left arm. There is no pain.

My front lower teeth are really sensitive and throbbing. My chest also feels tight and it is difficult to breathe. This started suddenly a couple of days ago. I know I grind my teeth and they are worn down. Please help.

I have a history of kidney stones and recently passed another stone. Today I woke up in terrible pain, feel like I am going to vomit, feel very hot, and there is blood in my stool. Could this be another kidney stone?
My 30-year-old friend had two drops of phenol after mistaking it for milk. He vomited and drank a lot of salt water. Please advise about side effects.
I have been wheezing on and off today and my inhaler does not seem to help as much as usual. I am getting worried.

I am 67 and having what feels like really bad menstrual cramps, which is strange because I thought I was long past that. It has been going on for a few days and is getting worse, with heavy bleeding and sharp pains. Should I come in?

I am 58 and had back surgery in August. X-rays looked normal, but I still have a lot of pain along my back, hip, and calf. I also have bowel problems alternating between constipation and chronic diarrhea, and I no longer have control over my bladder. This has been going on for at least six months, and I already had a colonoscopy.
My 72-year-old mother has a left femoral neck fracture. Is there any treatment other than surgery?
